```{r}
calc_auroc <- function(score, label) {
  ok <- !is.na(score) & !is.na(label)
  score <- score[ok]
  label <- as.integer(label[ok])

  n_pos <- sum(label == 1)
  n_neg <- sum(label == 0)

  if (n_pos == 0 || n_neg == 0) return(NA_real_)

  r <- rank(score, ties.method = "average")
  auc <- (sum(r[label == 1]) - n_pos * (n_pos + 1) / 2) / (n_pos * n_neg)
  as.numeric(auc)
}

calc_auprc <- function(score, label) {
  ok <- !is.na(score) & !is.na(label)
  score <- score[ok]
  label <- as.integer(label[ok])

  if (sum(label == 1) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  ord <- order(score, decreasing = TRUE)
  label <- label[ord]

  tp <- cumsum(label == 1)
  fp <- cumsum(label == 0)

  precision <- tp / (tp + fp)
  recall <- tp / sum(label == 1)

  recall_prev <- c(0, recall[-length(recall)])
  auprc <- sum((recall - recall_prev) * precision)

  as.numeric(auprc)
}

calc_top10_enrichment <- function(score, label) {
  ok <- !is.na(score) & !is.na(label)
  score <- score[ok]
  label <- as.integer(label[ok])

  n_top <- ceiling(length(score) * 0.10)
  top_idx <- order(score, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(n_top)]

  top_rate <- mean(label[top_idx] == 1)
  base_rate <- mean(label == 1)

  data.frame(
    top10_true_risk_fraction = top_rate,
    baseline_true_risk_fraction = base_rate,
    top10_enrichment = top_rate / base_rate
  )
}

extract_degas_score <- function(degas_result, n_cells) {
  if ("index" %in% colnames(degas_result)) {
    idx <- as.integer(degas_result$index)

    # DEGAS_python usually returns 0-based index
    if (min(idx, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      idx <- idx + 1
    }

    score <- rep(NA_real_, n_cells)
    score[idx] <- degas_result$hazard
    return(score)
  }

  if ("hazard" %in% colnames(degas_result)) {
    return(degas_result$hazard)
  }

  stop("Cannot find hazard/index columns in DEGAS result.")
}
```

### scRNA-seq
```{r}
simulate_sc_counts <- function(
    scenario = c("sim1_major_type", "sim2_subtype", "sim3_type4"),
    n_genes = 1000,
    n_cells = 3000,
    dropout_strength = 0.55,
    signal_strength = 0.45,
    seed = 1
) {
  scenario <- match.arg(scenario)
  set.seed(seed)

  genes <- paste0("Gene", seq_len(n_genes))

  groups <- c("Type1", "Type2", "Type3", "Type4_normal", "Type4_disease")

  n_per_group <- rep(floor(n_cells / length(groups)), length(groups))
  n_per_group[1] <- n_per_group[1] + n_cells - sum(n_per_group)

  base_log_mu <- rnorm(n_genes, mean = 1.2, sd = 0.8)

  group_log_mu <- matrix(base_log_mu, nrow = n_genes, ncol = length(groups))
  rownames(group_log_mu) <- genes
  colnames(group_log_mu) <- groups

  major_marker_map <- list(
    Type1 = 1:80,
    Type2 = 81:160,
    Type3 = 161:240,
    Type4 = 241:320
  )

  group_to_major <- c(
    Type1 = "Type1",
    Type2 = "Type2",
    Type3 = "Type3",
    Type4_normal = "Type4",
    Type4_disease = "Type4"
  )

  for (group_name in groups) {
    major_name <- group_to_major[[group_name]]
    marker_genes <- major_marker_map[[major_name]]
    marker_genes <- marker_genes[marker_genes <= n_genes]

    group_log_mu[marker_genes, group_name] <-
      group_log_mu[marker_genes, group_name] + signal_strength
  }

  disease_genes <- 401:500
  disease_genes <- disease_genes[disease_genes <= n_genes]
  group_log_mu[disease_genes, "Type4_disease"] <-
    group_log_mu[disease_genes, "Type4_disease"] + signal_strength

  counts_list <- list()
  meta_list <- list()
  cell_counter <- 1

  for (g in seq_along(groups)) {
    group_name <- groups[g]
    n_g <- n_per_group[g]

    mu <- exp(group_log_mu[, g])

    mat <- matrix(0, nrow = n_genes, ncol = n_g)

    for (j in seq_len(n_g)) {
      lib_factor <- exp(rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = 0.35))
      mu_j <- mu * lib_factor

      x <- rnbinom(n_genes, mu = mu_j, size = 3)

      p_drop <- dropout_strength * exp(-log1p(x) / 2)
      drop <- runif(n_genes) < p_drop
      x[drop] <- 0

      mat[, j] <- x
    }

    cell_names <- paste0("Cell", cell_counter:(cell_counter + n_g - 1))
    colnames(mat) <- cell_names
    rownames(mat) <- genes

    counts_list[[group_name]] <- mat

    major_type <- ifelse(grepl("Type4", group_name), "Type4", group_name)

    meta_list[[group_name]] <- data.frame(
      cell = cell_names,
      group = group_name,
      cellType = major_type,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    cell_counter <- cell_counter + n_g
  }

  sc_counts <- do.call(cbind, counts_list)
  sc_meta <- do.call(rbind, meta_list)
  rownames(sc_meta) <- sc_meta$cell

  if (scenario == "sim1_major_type") {
    sc_meta$true_risk <- as.integer(sc_meta$cellType == "Type1")
  } else if (scenario == "sim2_subtype") {
    sc_meta$true_risk <- as.integer(sc_meta$group == "Type4_disease")
  } else if (scenario == "sim3_type4") {
    sc_meta$true_risk <- as.integer(sc_meta$cellType == "Type4")
  }

  list(
    sc_counts = sc_counts,
    sc_meta = sc_meta
  )
}
```

### bulk
```{r}
simulate_bulk_from_sc <- function(
    sc_counts,
    sc_meta,
    scenario,
    n_patients = 200,
    cells_per_patient = 400,
    domain_shift_sd = 0.8,
    patient_noise_sd = 0.35,
    seed = 101
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  genes <- rownames(sc_counts)

  phenotype <- c(rep(1, n_patients / 2), rep(0, n_patients / 2))
  patient_names <- paste0("Patient", seq_len(n_patients))

  bulk_counts <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(sc_counts), ncol = n_patients)
  rownames(bulk_counts) <- genes
  colnames(bulk_counts) <- patient_names

  ## global bulk-vs-sc systematic domain shift
  ## this is independent of disease status
  bulk_domain_shift <- exp(rnorm(nrow(sc_counts), mean = 0, sd = domain_shift_sd))

  ## systematic bias genes unrelated to true risk
  ## this makes no-transfer more likely to be distracted
  bias_genes <- 601:750
  bias_vector <- rep(1, nrow(sc_counts))
  bias_vector[bias_genes] <- exp(0.8)

  sample_cells <- function(prob_by_group) {
    prob_by_group <- prob_by_group / sum(prob_by_group)
    expected_n <- cells_per_patient * prob_by_group
    n_by_group <- floor(expected_n)
    remainder <- cells_per_patient - sum(n_by_group)

    if (remainder > 0) {
      add_idx <- order(expected_n - n_by_group, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(remainder)]
      n_by_group[add_idx] <- n_by_group[add_idx] + 1
    }

    sampled_cells <- c()

    for (grp in names(prob_by_group)) {
      n_grp <- n_by_group[[grp]]
      if (n_grp == 0) next

      candidates <- sc_meta$cell[
        sc_meta$group == grp | sc_meta$cellType == grp
      ]

      sampled_cells <- c(
        sampled_cells,
        sample(candidates, n_grp, replace = TRUE)
      )
    }

    sampled_cells
  }

  for (i in seq_len(n_patients)) {
    is_disease <- phenotype[i] == 1

    if (scenario == "sim1_major_type") {
      if (is_disease) {
        probs <- c(
          Type1 = 0.35,
          Type2 = 0.216,
          Type3 = 0.216,
          Type4_normal = 0.218,
          Type4_disease = 0.00
        )
      } else {
        probs <- c(
          Type1 = 0.25,
          Type2 = 0.25,
          Type3 = 0.25,
          Type4_normal = 0.25,
          Type4_disease = 0.00
        )
      }
    }

    if (scenario == "sim2_subtype") {
      if (is_disease) {
        probs <- c(
          Type1 = 0.25,
          Type2 = 0.25,
          Type3 = 0.25,
          Type4_normal = 0.05,
          Type4_disease = 0.2
        )
      } else {
        probs <- c(
          Type1 = 0.25,
          Type2 = 0.25,
          Type3 = 0.25,
          Type4_normal = 0.25,
          Type4_disease = 0.00
        )
      }
    }

    if (scenario == "sim3_type4") {
      if (is_disease) {
        probs <- c(
          Type1 = 0.2,
          Type2 = 0.2,
          Type3 = 0.2,
          Type4_normal = 0.25,
          Type4_disease = 0.15
        )
      } else {
        probs <- c(
          Type1 = 0.25,
          Type2 = 0.25,
          Type3 = 0.25,
          Type4_normal = 0.25,
          Type4_disease = 0.00
        )
      }
    }

    cells <- sample_cells(probs)

    x <- rowSums(sc_counts[, cells, drop = FALSE])

    ## apply systematic bulk domain shift
    x <- x * bulk_domain_shift

    ## apply unrelated patient-level bias
    x <- x * bias_vector

    ## patient-specific noise
    patient_shift <- exp(rnorm(length(x), mean = 0, sd = patient_noise_sd))
    x <- x * patient_shift

    ## count noise
    noise <- rnorm(length(x), mean = 0, sd = sqrt(pmax(x, 1)))
    x <- round(pmax(0, x + noise))

    bulk_counts[, i] <- x
  }

  list(
    bulk_counts = bulk_counts,
    phenotype = phenotype
  )
}
```


### one run
```{r}
run_one_degas_method <- function(
    sc_counts,
    sc_meta,
    bulk_counts,
    phenotype,
    scenario,
    method_name,
    transfer_type,
    lambda3,
    num_layers = 3,
    tot_seeds = 1,
    save_root = "simulation_runs"
) {
  cat("Preprocessing:", scenario, method_name, "\n")

  data <- DEGAS_preprocessing(
    scst_list = sc_counts,
    sclab = sc_meta$cellType,
    patdata = bulk_counts,
    phenotype = phenotype,
    bulk_hvg = FALSE,
    bulk_de = FALSE,
    sc_de = FALSE,
    add_genes = rownames(sc_counts)
  )

  # run_DEGAS_SCST reads this global variable
  n_st_classes <<- length(unique(sc_meta$cellType))

  save_dir <- file.path(save_root, scenario, method_name)
  dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  cat("Running DEGASv2:", scenario, method_name, "\n")

  degas_sc_results <- run_DEGAS_SCST(
    data_list = data,
    model_type = "ClassClass",
    data_name = paste0("simulation_", scenario, "_", method_name),
    loss_type = "cross_entropy",
    transfer_type = transfer_type,
    num_layers = num_layers,
    lambda3 = lambda3,
    model_save_dir = save_dir,
    tot_seeds = tot_seeds
  )

  score <- extract_degas_score(degas_sc_results, nrow(sc_meta))

  data.frame(
    cell = sc_meta$cell,
    scenario = scenario,
    method = method_name,
    score = score,
    true_risk = sc_meta$true_risk,
    cellType = sc_meta$cellType,
    group = sc_meta$group,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

### simulation scenario
```{r}
run_one_scenario <- function(
    scenario,
    seed = 1,
    tot_seeds = 1,
    num_layers = 3
) {
  cat("Generating scenario:", scenario, "\n")

  sc <- simulate_sc_counts(
    scenario = scenario,
    n_genes = 1000,
    n_cells = 3000,
    dropout_strength = ifelse(scenario == "sim3_type4", 0.55, 0.45),
    seed = seed
  )

  bulk <- simulate_bulk_from_sc(
    sc_counts = sc$sc_counts,
    sc_meta = sc$sc_meta,
    scenario = scenario,
    n_patients = 200,
    cells_per_patient = 400,
    domain_shift_sd = 1.0,
    patient_noise_sd = 0.35,
    seed = seed + 100
  )

  dir.create(file.path("simulation_results", scenario), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  write.csv(sc$sc_counts, file.path("simulation_results", scenario, "sc_counts.csv"))
  write.csv(sc$sc_meta, file.path("simulation_results", scenario, "sc_meta.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(bulk$bulk_counts, file.path("simulation_results", scenario, "bulk_counts.csv"))
  write.csv(
    data.frame(patient = colnames(bulk$bulk_counts), phenotype = bulk$phenotype),
    file.path("simulation_results", scenario, "patient_labels.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  methods <- list(
    Wasserstein = list(transfer_type = "Wasserstein", lambda3 = 3),
    MMD = list(transfer_type = "MMD", lambda3 = 3),
    NoTransfer = list(transfer_type = "Wasserstein", lambda3 = 0)
  )

  all_scores <- list()

  for (m in names(methods)) {
    all_scores[[m]] <- run_one_degas_method(
      sc_counts = sc$sc_counts,
      sc_meta = sc$sc_meta,
      bulk_counts = bulk$bulk_counts,
      phenotype = bulk$phenotype,
      scenario = scenario,
      method_name = m,
      transfer_type = methods[[m]]$transfer_type,
      lambda3 = methods[[m]]$lambda3,
      num_layers = num_layers,
      tot_seeds = tot_seeds
    )

    gc()
  }

  do.call(rbind, all_scores)
}
```

### run
```{r}
dir.create("simulation_results", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("simulation_runs", showWarnings = FALSE)

scenarios <- c(
  "sim1_major_type",
  "sim2_subtype",
  "sim3_type4"
)

seeds <- 1:10
all_score_list <- list()
counter <- 1

for (sd in seeds) {
  for (scn in scenarios) {
    cat("Running simulation seed:", sd, "scenario:", scn, "\n")

    all_score_list[[counter]] <- run_one_scenario(
      scenario = scn,
      seed = sd,
      tot_seeds = 1,   # keep this 1; outer loop already repeats simulation seeds
      num_layers = 3
    ) %>%
      mutate(sim_seed = sd)

    counter <- counter + 1
    gc()
  }
}

score_df <- do.call(rbind, all_score_list)

write.csv(
  score_df,
  "simulation_results/simulation_cell_scores.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
metric_df <- score_df %>%
  group_by(sim_seed, scenario, method) %>%
  summarise(
    AUROC = calc_auroc(score, true_risk),
    AUPRC = calc_auprc(score, true_risk),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

top_df <- score_df %>%
  group_by(sim_seed, scenario, method) %>%
  group_modify(~ calc_top10_enrichment(.x$score, .x$true_risk)) %>%
  ungroup()

metric_df <- left_join(
  metric_df,
  top_df,
  by = c("sim_seed", "scenario", "method")
)

summary_df <- metric_df %>%
  group_by(scenario, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_AUROC = mean(AUROC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_AUROC = sd(AUROC, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_AUROC = sd_AUROC / sqrt(n),
    ci95_AUROC = 1.96 * se_AUROC,
    mean_AUPRC = mean(AUPRC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_AUPRC = sd(AUPRC, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_AUPRC = sd_AUPRC / sqrt(n),
    ci95_AUPRC = 1.96 * se_AUPRC,
    mean_top10_enrichment = mean(top10_enrichment, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_top10_enrichment = sd(top10_enrichment, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(metric_df)
print(summary_df)

write.csv(
  metric_df,
  "simulation_results/simulation_metrics_by_seed.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  summary_df,
  "simulation_results/simulation_metrics_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### panel A
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

root_dir <- "/N/project/ADNDD/Foundation/DEGAS_torch/simulation"
setwd(root_dir)

dir.create("simulation_results/sim2_subtype", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("simulation_figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

remove_umap_outliers <- function(df, group_col = "group", x_col = "UMAP_1", y_col = "UMAP_2",
                                 cutoff = 3.5) {
  df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
    mutate(
      center_x = median(.data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      center_y = median(.data[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      dist_to_center = sqrt((.data[[x_col]] - center_x)^2 + (.data[[y_col]] - center_y)^2),
      mad_dist = mad(dist_to_center, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      med_dist = median(dist_to_center, na.rm = TRUE),
      keep_cell = dist_to_center <= med_dist + cutoff * mad_dist
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(keep_cell) %>%
    select(-center_x, -center_y, -dist_to_center, -mad_dist, -med_dist, -keep_cell)
}

set.seed(1)

sc <- simulate_sc_counts(
  scenario = "sim2_subtype",
  n_genes = 1000,
  n_cells = 3000,
  dropout_strength = 0.35,
  signal_strength = 0.70,
  seed = 1
)

sc_counts <- sc$sc_counts
sc_meta <- sc$sc_meta
rownames(sc_meta) <- sc_meta$cell
sc_meta <- sc_meta[colnames(sc_counts), , drop = FALSE]

write.csv(sc_counts, "simulation_results/sim2_subtype/sc_counts.csv")
write.csv(sc_meta, "simulation_results/sim2_subtype/sc_meta.csv", row.names = FALSE)

seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sc_counts, meta.data = sc_meta)

seu <- NormalizeData(seu, verbose = FALSE)
seu <- FindVariableFeatures(seu, nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
seu <- ScaleData(seu, verbose = FALSE)

# Panel A emphasizes major cell-type structure.
# DEGAS training can still use the full expression matrix saved above.
major_marker_genes <- paste0("Gene", 1:320)
disease_subtype_genes <- paste0("Gene", 401:500)
background_genes <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seu), disease_subtype_genes)

viz_features <- unique(c(major_marker_genes, background_genes))
viz_features <- setdiff(viz_features, disease_subtype_genes)
viz_features <- intersect(viz_features, rownames(seu))

seu <- RunPCA(seu, features = viz_features, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)

seu <- RunUMAP(
  seu,
  dims = 1:12,
  min.dist = 0.35,
  spread = 1.2,
  n.neighbors = 55,
  verbose = FALSE
)

umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(seu, "umap"))
colnames(umap_df) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
umap_df$cell <- rownames(umap_df)
umap_df$group <- seu$group
umap_df$cellType <- seu$cellType
umap_df$true_risk <- seu$true_risk

write.csv(
  umap_df,
  "simulation_results/sim2_subtype/sc_umap_panel_A_raw_all_cells.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

umap_df_plot <- remove_umap_outliers(
  umap_df,
  group_col = "group",
  x_col = "UMAP_1",
  y_col = "UMAP_2",
  cutoff = 3.5
)

write.csv(
  umap_df_plot,
  "simulation_results/sim2_subtype/sc_umap_panel_A_plot_cells.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

umap_df_plot$group <- factor(
  umap_df_plot$group,
  levels = c("Type1", "Type2", "Type3", "Type4_normal", "Type4_disease")
)

group_cols <- c(
  "Type1" = "#E64B35",
  "Type2" = "#4DBBD5",
  "Type3" = "#00A087",
  "Type4_normal" = "#2F5597",
  "Type4_disease" = "#F4A261"
)

df_other <- umap_df_plot %>%
  filter(!group %in% c("Type4_normal", "Type4_disease"))

set.seed(22)
df_type4 <- umap_df_plot %>%
  filter(group %in% c("Type4_normal", "Type4_disease")) %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 1)

p_panel_a <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = df_other,
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = group),
    size = 0.85,
    alpha = 0.90,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df_type4,
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = group),
    size = 0.75,
    alpha = 0.68,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = group_cols,
    breaks = c("Type1", "Type2", "Type3", "Type4_disease", "Type4_normal"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.65, "cm"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1),
      ncol = 1
    )
  )

p_panel_a

ggsave(
  "simulation_figures/Fig_simulation_panel_A_umap.pdf",
  p_panel_a,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 5.4,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(

  p_panel_a,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 5.4,
  dpi = 600
)
```

### panel B-D
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

root_dir <- "/N/project/ADNDD/Foundation/DEGAS_torch/simulation"
setwd(root_dir)

dir.create("simulation_figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("simulation_results/composition", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

group_cols <- c(
  "Type1" = "#E64B35",
  "Type2" = "#4DBBD5",
  "Type3" = "#00A087",
  "Type4_normal" = "#2F5597",
  "Type4_disease" = "#F4A261"
)

make_composition_df <- function(scenario) {
  if (scenario == "sim1_major_type") {
    df <- data.frame(
      patient_status = rep(c("Normal", "Disease"), each = 5),
      cell_group = rep(c("Type1", "Type2", "Type3", "Type4_normal", "Type4_disease"), times = 2),
      proportion = c(
        0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.00,
        0.50, 1 / 6, 1 / 6, 1 / 6, 0.00
      )
    )
  }

  if (scenario == "sim2_subtype") {
    df <- data.frame(
      patient_status = rep(c("Normal", "Disease"), each = 5),
      cell_group = rep(c("Type1", "Type2", "Type3", "Type4_normal", "Type4_disease"), times = 2),
      proportion = c(
        0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.00,
        0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.00, 0.25
      )
    )
  }

  if (scenario == "sim3_type4") {
    df <- data.frame(
      patient_status = rep(c("Normal", "Disease"), each = 5),
      cell_group = rep(c("Type1", "Type2", "Type3", "Type4_normal", "Type4_disease"), times = 2),
      proportion = c(
        0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.00,
        1 / 6, 1 / 6, 1 / 6, 0.30, 0.20
      )
    )
  }

  df$scenario <- scenario
  df
}

composition_df <- bind_rows(
  make_composition_df("sim1_major_type"),
  make_composition_df("sim2_subtype"),
  make_composition_df("sim3_type4")
)

composition_df <- composition_df %>%
  mutate(
    patient_status = factor(patient_status, levels = c("Normal", "Disease")),
    cell_group = factor(
      cell_group,
      levels = c("Type1", "Type2", "Type3", "Type4_normal", "Type4_disease")
    )
  )

write.csv(
  composition_df,
  "simulation_results/composition/simulation_patient_composition_design.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

plot_composition_panel <- function(df, scenario_id, panel_title) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(scenario == scenario_id)

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = patient_status, y = proportion, fill = cell_group)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = group_cols,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
      labels = c("0", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00"),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = panel_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Proportion"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 8)
    )
}

p_b <- plot_composition_panel(
  composition_df,
  "sim1_major_type",
  "Simulation 1 patients"
)

p_c <- plot_composition_panel(
  composition_df,
  "sim2_subtype",
  "Simulation 2 patients"
)

p_d <- plot_composition_panel(
  composition_df,
  "sim3_type4",
  "Simulation 3 patients"
)

p_bcd <- p_b + p_c + p_d + plot_layout(nrow = 1)

p_bcd

ggsave(
  "simulation_figures/Fig_simulation_panels_BCD_patient_composition.pdf",
  p_bcd,
  width = 10.5,
  height = 3.5,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  "simulation_figures/Fig_simulation_panels_BCD_patient_composition.png",
  p_bcd,
  width = 10.5,
  height = 3.5,
  dpi = 600
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)

method_order <- c("NoTransfer", "MMD", "Wasserstein")
method_labels <- c(
  NoTransfer = "No_transfer",
  MMD = "MMD",
  Wasserstein = "Wasserstein"
)

scenario_order <- c("sim1_major_type", "sim2_subtype", "sim3_type4")
scenario_labels <- c(
  sim1_major_type = "Simulation 1",
  sim2_subtype = "Simulation 2",
  sim3_type4 = "Simulation 3"
)

plot_df <- metric_df %>%
  mutate(
    method_raw = method,
    method = factor(method, levels = method_order, labels = method_labels),
    scenario_raw = scenario,
    scenario = factor(
      scenario,
      levels = scenario_order,
      labels = scenario_labels
    )
  )

auc_wide <- metric_df %>%
  select(sim_seed, scenario, method, AUROC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = AUROC)

pair_defs <- data.frame(
  group1 = c("Wasserstein", "Wasserstein", "MMD"),
  group2 = c("NoTransfer", "MMD", "NoTransfer"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

paired_test_one <- function(df, g1, g2) {
  x <- df[[g1]]
  y <- df[[g2]]
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  
  if (sum(keep) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      n_pairs = sum(keep),
      mean_group1 = NA_real_,
      mean_group2 = NA_real_,
      mean_diff = NA_real_,
      p_greater = NA_real_,
      p_two_sided = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  data.frame(
    n_pairs = sum(keep),
    mean_group1 = mean(x[keep], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_group2 = mean(y[keep], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff = mean(x[keep] - y[keep], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_greater = wilcox.test(
      x[keep], y[keep],
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE,
      alternative = "greater"
    )$p.value,
    p_two_sided = wilcox.test(
      x[keep], y[keep],
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )$p.value
  )
}

pval_df <- bind_rows(lapply(scenario_order, function(scn) {
  df_scn <- auc_wide %>% filter(scenario == scn)
  
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pair_defs)), function(i) {
    g1 <- pair_defs$group1[i]
    g2 <- pair_defs$group2[i]
    
    cbind(
      data.frame(
        scenario = scn,
        group1 = g1,
        group2 = g2,
        comparison = paste(g1, ">", g2),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ),
      paired_test_one(df_scn, g1, g2)
    )
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_greater = p.adjust(p_greater, method = "BH"),
    p_adj_two_sided = p.adjust(p_two_sided, method = "BH"),
    scenario_label = scenario_labels[scenario],
    group1_label = method_labels[group1],
    group2_label = method_labels[group2]
  )

print(pval_df)

setwd("/N/project/ADNDD/Foundation/DEGAS_torch/simulation")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)



method_order <- c("NoTransfer", "MMD", "Wasserstein")
method_labels <- c(
  NoTransfer = "No_transfer",
  MMD = "MMD",
  Wasserstein = "Wasserstein"
)

scenario_order <- c("sim1_major_type", "sim2_subtype", "sim3_type4")
scenario_labels <- c(
  sim1_major_type = "Simulation 1",
  sim2_subtype = "Simulation 2",
  sim3_type4 = "Simulation 3"
)

plot_df <- metric_df %>%
  mutate(
    method_raw = method,
    method = factor(method, levels = method_order, labels = method_labels),
    scenario_raw = scenario,
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_order, labels = scenario_labels)
  )

auc_wide <- metric_df %>%
  select(sim_seed, scenario, method, AUROC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = AUROC)

pair_defs <- data.frame(
  group1 = c("Wasserstein", "Wasserstein", "MMD"),
  group2 = c("NoTransfer", "MMD", "NoTransfer"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

paired_test_one <- function(df, g1, g2) {
  x <- df[[g1]]
  y <- df[[g2]]
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  
  if (sum(keep) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      n_pairs = sum(keep),
      mean_group1 = NA_real_,
      mean_group2 = NA_real_,
      mean_diff = NA_real_,
      p_greater = NA_real_,
      p_two_sided = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  data.frame(
    n_pairs = sum(keep),
    mean_group1 = mean(x[keep], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_group2 = mean(y[keep], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff = mean(x[keep] - y[keep], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_greater = wilcox.test(
      x[keep], y[keep],
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE,
      alternative = "greater"
    )$p.value,
    p_two_sided = wilcox.test(
      x[keep], y[keep],
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )$p.value
  )
}

pval_df <- bind_rows(lapply(scenario_order, function(scn) {
  df_scn <- auc_wide %>% filter(scenario == scn)
  
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pair_defs)), function(i) {
    g1 <- pair_defs$group1[i]
    g2 <- pair_defs$group2[i]
    
    cbind(
      data.frame(
        scenario_raw = scn,
        group1_raw = g1,
        group2_raw = g2,
        comparison = paste(g1, ">", g2),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ),
      paired_test_one(df_scn, g1, g2)
    )
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_greater = p.adjust(p_greater, method = "BH"),
    p_adj_two_sided = p.adjust(p_two_sided, method = "BH"),
    scenario = factor(scenario_labels[scenario_raw], levels = scenario_labels),
    group1 = factor(method_labels[group1_raw], levels = method_labels[method_order]),
    group2 = factor(method_labels[group2_raw], levels = method_labels[method_order])
  )

print(pval_df)

write.csv(

  row.names = FALSE
)

p_to_star <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p), NA_character_,
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001, "***",
      ifelse(
        p < 0.01, "**",
        ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "ns")
      )
    )
  )
}

panel_y <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(scenario_raw) %>%
  summarise(
    y_base = max(AUROC, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

annot_df <- pval_df %>%
  filter(
    group1_raw == "Wasserstein",
    group2_raw %in% c("NoTransfer", "MMD"),
    mean_diff > 0,
    p_adj_greater < 0.05
  ) %>%
  group_by(scenario_raw) %>%
  arrange(group2_raw, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = 0.975 + 0.025 * row_number(),
    label = p_to_star(p_adj_greater)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```
